Well, it's a little late now, but I will try to help anyone that reads this post later. No exp. with methadone, but standard dosages are between 2 and 7 grams, depending on the tolerance. Lower dosages are said to be energetic, while larger ones more sedating. It comes in different colors and strains, most are just marketing gimmicks. The strain is simply the location it was harvested, the 'color' is what kind of effects to expect. Reds are supposed to be more sedating, whites more energizing, and greens a mix of both. Personally reds have only ever given me headaches, whites sometimes have a jaw clenching/ over wired feeling. Greens and golds are my go-to for pain management. Golds and yellows vary wildly between vendors, some are bright green and some dark brown. Some are fermented or oxidized to change around the alkaloid profiles. Know that there is a "less is more" quality of kratom, certain properties make it so when you take a larger dose it ends up cancelling out some alkaloids instead of increasing the effects. Everyone's physiology is different, and every different kratom trees alk. profile is different. A tree grown in Malaysia and one grown in Bali will have very different alks, even though it is the same genetics. Someone going through opiate w/d probably won't notice or care about such things, but if managing chronic pain it becomes important to know how certain varieties will effect you personally, as some will help tremendously and others may needlessly hinder cognition. Eddits r/kratom has a weekly list of approved vendors that have been vetted as being unadulterated and generally safe, but there is always risk when ingesting any natural psychoactive substance, be it St. Johns Wort or coffee, so do extensive research into any interactions it may have with any other substances.
